dedupe_keys.name: energy exchanges on the gccia interconnector

description: Energy Exchanges on the GCCIA Interconnector is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains Energy Exchanges on the GCCIA Interconnector for 2010-2019. Data collected from The GCC Interconnection Authority. Notes: - Data for unscheduled energy and scheduled compensation are unavailable for the years 2017-2019. - Unscheduled energy is either compensated in kind or in cash. Coverage: the GCC states (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are Insight. The portal shows 2022-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
